headline: Nielsen is leaning more on wearables to hear what people are watching
summary: Nielsen will use wearable device data to improve viewership measurement. This aims to enhance accuracy for streaming era data. Key enhancements are being added to their data capturing process.

headline: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
summary: Google Gemini is launching a new student hub for back-to-school. It serves as a central place for research, flashcards, and quizzes. Study notebooks will support graphs, images, and test date tracking.

headline: Watch Valve set up the Steam Frame in its own leaked videos
summary: Valve accidentally leaked videos of its new Steam Frame VR headset. The videos showed unboxing, setup, and accessories. They appeared on the ARM Steam client but were quickly removed.

headline: The wearable future is stuck in weird, experimental, existential limbo
summary: A Verge reviewer discusses the current state of wearable technology. The article explores the experimental and uncertain future of wearables. The reviewer tested the Google Pixel Watch 5 as an example.

headline: LEGO Fans Are Closer Than Ever to Getting a Studio Ghibli Set
summary: LEGO fans are eagerly awaiting a Studio Ghibli set. The possibility of this collaboration is now closer. Enthusiasts hope for iconic Ghibli designs in LEGO form.

headline: Director of Marvel’s Wolverine Responds After Extended Gameplay Footage Sparks Backlash
summary: Marvel's Wolverine director, Mike Daly, addressed recent backlash. Criticism arose from extended gameplay footage. Daly responded to the negative reception online.

headline: What to Expect at IFA 2026: AI Is the Name of the Game
summary: IFA 2026 is anticipated as a significant event. Artificial Intelligence (AI) will be a central theme. The event is described as a "cultural playground" beyond a mere trade show.

headline: Modern Warfare 4 Beta Reveals Multiplayer Matchmaking Plans, Will Continue to Use Divisive New Matchmaking System
summary: Modern Warfare 4 beta will use a controversial matchmaking system. This new system is in addition to last year's open matchmaking. The decision continues to spark division among players.

headline: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are reportedly moving back to the UK. Their children, Archie and Lilibet, are enrolled in a UK school. The children are expected to start school in September.

headline: Couple and teenage daughter who died in water off Shoreham named by police
summary: Police identified a family who died in the sea off Shoreham. The family, a couple and their teenage daughter, travelled from London. They entered the sea for a swim when the tragedy occurred.

headline: Track defect found on approach to site of Lewes derailment, initial report says
summary: An initial report found a track defect near the Lewes derailment site. The RAIB investigation revealed an "irregularity" on the approach. The defect is linked to the recent train derailment.

headline: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
summary: Israel confirmed its soldiers fired at the car where Hind Rajab was killed. A criminal investigation into the incident has been opened. Five-year-old Hind initially survived but was later found dead with relatives.
